verse.text: With the blessings of our elders and the grace of the divine, two families come together and two hearts become one — for this life and every life after.

items.title: First Hello
items.text: A shared umbrella on a rainy evening in Pune turned into a conversation neither of us wanted to end.

items.title: Growing Together
items.text: Road trips, late-night chai and two families slowly becoming one big, noisy circle.

items.title: The Question
items.text: On a quiet morning at the lakeside in Udaipur, Vihaan asked — and Meera said yes.

items.title: Our Forever
items.text: Now we invite you to bless us as we take our seven steps together.

gift.heading: Blessings & Gifts
gift.message: Your presence and blessings are the most precious gift. If you would still like to give something, a contribution towards our new home would mean a lot to us.
